title: King Charles and senior politicians lead UK Remembrance Sunday service at Cenotaph – live
summary: Two-minute silence held at 11am GMT, with commemorations also taking place across the UK, including in Edinburgh, Cardiff and Belfast The Prince of Wales , dressed in Royal Air Force uniform in the rank of Wing Commander, saluted after laying his wreath at the Cenotaph. He was followed by the Duke of Edinburgh , with wreaths also laid on behalf of the Duke of Kent and the Princess Royal. Continue reading...
